entries.title: planetscale@1.0.0: feat(plugins): add PlanetScale plugin (#9886)
entries.note: feat(plugins): add PlanetScale plugin Add a PlanetScale plugin that proxies PlanetScale's official hosted MCP server ( https://mcp.pscale.dev/mcp/planetscale ). The planetscale_mcp connector uses the dynamic client: PlanetScale's authorization server (issuer https://api.planetscale.com ) offers RFC 7591 registration and S256 PKCE. It requests no explicit scopes, so PlanetScale grants its default MCP scope set, which includes openid/email/profile. The user picks per-organization and per-database access on PlanetScale's consent screen. Identity comes from the OIDC userinfo endpoint (sub, email). Also adds the desktop icon (SiPlanetscale), link unfurl for planetscale.com, the catalog entry, and a docs page. fix(plugins): key PlanetScale identity on email, not pairwise sub PlanetScale advertises subject_types_supported: ["pairwise"], so sub can differ between client registrations.
